jobs.description:
(Senior) FIX Engineer Specialist
•
Zurich, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As a (Senior) FIX Engineer Specialist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are in a team which develops enhancements and new solutions not only for our group-wide execution trading system (FIS Cross-Asset Trading and Risk Suite - Front Arena AMS and Avaloq) but also for surrounding systems. Additionally, you provide customization and workflow definition tasks, mainly for FIX interfaces, including project management work.
Your Responsibilities
• Customize FIX interfaces
• Define IT processes and workflows within our order routing and trading systems, e.g. FIS Cross-Asset Trading and Risk Suite - Front Arena AMS (market access, order routing, settlement) and Avaloq
• Implement, configure and test new functionalities
• Analyse and support on business level
• Create technical documentation
Your Profile
• Higher education (university / FH) in IT or natural sciences, with 5 years of practical experience in the field of FIX interfaces
• Required industry specific knowledge as well as basic knowledge in Trading (Eq, FI, Deriv, FX)
• Hands-on experience with FIX Protocol, TLS, encryption and profound IT-affinity, in particular with Windows NOS, TCP/IP
• Knowledge of FIS Cross-Asset Trading and Risk Suite; Front Arena AMS, Avaloq and/or Python is an advantage
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, ability to work with various stakeholders and willingness to take responsibility
• Capability to work independently and ability to work under pressure
• Fluency in English; fluency in German is a plus

•
Entrepreneurial spirit in a family owned bank

•
Zurich, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As Senior FMI Business Analyst you support our project team in various regulatory financial market infrastructure related initiatives, such as the implementation of the MIFIR requirements, as well as optimization of the current setup of EMIR Refit and FMIA related processes.
Your Responsibilities
• Derive precise business requirements from regulatory guidelines and internal non-regulatory needs
• Perform gap analyses to determine applicable requirements based on existing trading and operational processes
• Develop pragmatic solutions with technical experts and prepare business requirement documents and IT tickets
• Organize workshops and lead conceptual discussions with stakeholders including Front Office and IT
• Conduct system and user acceptance testing while discussing results with relevant stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with various stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
• Analyze complex business processes to identify opportunities for optimization within existing setups
Your Profile
• At least 6 years of proven experience in the field of financial market regulation and with regulatory frameworks such as EMIR, MiFIR, FMIA, or SFTR
• Strong analytical skills and a well-structured, practical and pragmatic approach
• Ability to quickly understand complex problems and develop robust practical solutions
• Strong understanding of trading processes for cash and derivative products, including their lifecycle events
• Solid knowledge of front-to-back processes concerning trade booking
• Ability to work independently, drive projects forward and meet strict deadlines
• Excellent stakeholder management and a collaborative approach with various stakeholders at all seniority levels
